title: pretty good app! just add the reschedule option.
body: hey, I like this app. it’s a pretty good way to check my habits and see how my progress goes but the one thing that I would really like to have is a chance to add another reminder (for example reschedule for an hour or reschedule until the afternoon) just like Apple reminders or set an early reminder. It’s still good app, but if you have this feature then I’ll be more happy.
author: JyelexPlays

title: Not so Boring Habit Tracker
body:
* Aesthetic Appeal: This habit tracker app stands out with its stunning elegance and beautiful design. The user interface is a perfect blend of simplicity and sophistication, making it a pleasure to use. Each element is thoughtfully placed, contributing to a clean and visually appealing interface that users will find delightful.

* Key Strengths:
    * Visually stunning minimalist layout and superb skin/wallpapers.
    * Direct and uncomplicated functionality.
    * Smooth, uncluttered navigation
    * Just like any other Not Boring apps, Crisp music (Chef’s kiss).

* Some Weaknesses and Recommendations:
    * Removing a habit (or Checkmarks) can be a bit tricky. You need to press and hold the key to remove, and it uses the default Apple layout. (This is a minor nitpick, but it would have been better if the removal layout adhered to the theme.)
    * No Apple Watch support. (Integration with wearable devices, like smartwatches in the future maybe?).
    * No (?) cloud support (I bough the Super membership and I use both the iPhone and iPad almost regularly. It seems that I can’t find any cloud support that let’s me sync my progress to my devices.) - Let me know if there is.

* Overall Rating: ★★★★☆ (4/5 stars)

 Should I recommend it? 100% yes.
author: TheDailyCommenter
